title: tsw/gap/v1
description: A hole a producer knows of, handed to tsdb-writer on the internal subject tsw.v1.writer_gaps and recorded in writer_gaps (LESSONS B-13: holes are holes). Owned by uspace-authority (WP-9); rid-ingest (WP-7) publishes one for every queued batch it sheds. Internal to this system, no 04 §2 envelope. With from_seq > 0 the Nats-Msg-Id is the record's dedupe key (a retried publish is one hole); otherwise the record's TSW sequence is (two such records are two holes).

table.description: The table the lost rows were for.

from_seq.description: First sequence of the hole in stream; 0 when unknown.

to_seq.description: Last sequence of the hole; not before from_seq.

cause.description: Why, for example ingest_queue_full, ingest_queue_age, ingest_queue_corrupt.

count.description: How much was lost, in count_unit.

at.description: When the producer recorded the hole, on its clock.

receiver_id.description: The receiver whose observations were lost, when one.

stream.description: The stream whose sequences from_seq and to_seq number; INGEST when absent (rid-ingest's records).
